scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT output files is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; result-level comparison against paper gold with code-tolerant percentage windows is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference λ, ω_log, T_c for A15, P4_2/mmc, Cccm; enthalpy ordering expectation.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4 caption and text: A15 λ=1.82, ω_log=989 K; P4_2/mmc λ=1.56, ω_log=737 K; Cccm λ=1.60, ω_log=793 K. Tc values from text: 140 K, 90 K, 100 K at μ*=0.13. Enthalpy ordering from Figure 2 (Cccm most stable).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from published numerical values; tolerances chosen to absorb DFT code differences (15% for λ, 10% for ω_log, 20% for T_c).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported quantities for the exact conditions being reproduced; they are the authoritative ground truth for reproduction correctness.

outputs.description: Computed physical properties for the three GeH3 crystal structures at r_s=1.52.

output_contract.notes: The submitted file will be checked for structural correctness and compared against hidden reference values.

steps.description: All three structures must be dynamically stable (no imaginary phonon modes).
Enthalpy per atom must satisfy Cccm < P4_2/mmc < A15.
For at least two structures, λ, ω_log, and T_c must all be within tolerance of the paper’s values.
For each structure, static_energy + zpe must equal enthalpy within 0.001 Ry.
